Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your offer and for your kind words about a long-term partnership. We value that spirit and want to build on it.

Our data gives a different picture from your offer:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We would like steady, reliable call-offs with you and punctual payment on our side. Here is our proposal:

Our proposal: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.

We are firm on quality and price, and we hope this gives us a solid basis to move forward together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

I checked your data on delivery and past prices, fair enough, we had some hiccups. As to the delivery record and price history data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. You mentioned punctual payment, which we really need since you are often late; if you pay on time, I can do 46.50 EUR. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

I can agree to the 1500 ppm, but 500 EUR chargeback is too much, so I changed it to 150 EUR. 

So our current Angebot is a price of €49.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint: €46.50 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.
